d: At least 11 civilians have reportedly been killed in a strike on Yemen's Taiz governorate, according to media affiliated with the Houthi armed group. The reported attack hit a residential building in al-Turbah, with local sources claiming that most of the victims were children; three people are still missing beneath the rubble. The reports have not been independently verified, and Saudi Arabia's-led coalition had not immediately commented on the alleged airstrike. Separately, the coalition said it had destroyed a Houthi drone launched towards Saudi Arabia's Riyadh region. Hem Saroya tells…
